name: Michael Jordan
hook: Six NBA titles, Space Jam, and the shoe empire — the basketball star clues keep circling back to.

facts.label: North Carolina
facts.statement: He grew up in Wilmington, North Carolina, and played at the University of North Carolina for Dean Smith alongside Sam Perkins and James Worthy.

facts.label: Chicago Bulls
facts.statement: He won six NBA titles with the Chicago Bulls, with Scottie Pippen as his second option, and his 1998 game-winner over Bryon Russell was voted the NBA's top playoff moment.

facts.label: Space Jam
facts.statement: In the 1996 film Space Jam, Bugs Bunny recruits him to beat the Monstars; R. Kelly's "I Believe I Can Fly" was written for it.

facts.label: Air Jordans
facts.statement: His Air Jordans helped make Nike the top athletic shoe seller, and he also pitched Gatorade and Hanes.

facts.label: the Dream Team
facts.statement: He played for the 1992 Olympic Dream Team with Magic Johnson, Larry Bird, Charles Barkley and Karl Malone.

facts.label: Birmingham Barons
facts.statement: His 1994 baseball detour had him playing outfield for the minor league Birmingham Barons.

facts.label: Washington Wizards
facts.statement: As Washington Wizards general manager he drafted high schooler Kwame Brown No. 1 overall in 2001.
